mapper.sql:
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bas_material_sku k JOIN bas_material m ON m.id = k.material_id WHERE k.id = i.material_sku_id AND (k.code ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%' OR m.code ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%' OR m.name ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%'
OR upper(k.code) IN #{code} OR upper(m.code) IN #{code} )) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mrp_calc_item ci JOIN mrp_calc mc ON mc.id = ci.calc_id WHERE (ci.id = i.calc_item_id OR ci.id IN (SELECT t.calc_item_id FROM mrp_calc_transit t WHERE t.purchase_item_id = i.id)) AND (mc.no ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%' OR ci.order_nos ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%' OR ci.style_codes ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%'
OR upper(mc.no) IN #{code} OR string_to_array(upper(ci.order_nos), ',') && ARRAY[#{code}]::text[] OR string_to_array(upper(ci.style_codes), ',') && ARRAY[#{code}]::text[] ))

SELECT o.id, o.no, o.supplier_id, s.short_name AS supplier_name, s.status AS supplier_status, o.purchase_type, COALESCE(agg.item_count, 0) AS item_count, agg.first_sku_id, o.total_qty, o.total_amount, o.order_date, o.delivery_date, o.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, COALESCE(agg.received_qty, 0) AS received_qty, o.buyer_id, c.short_name AS company_name, o.status, o.version, o.create_by, o.create_time FROM pur_order o JOIN sup_supplier s ON s.id = o.supplier_id JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id JOIN bas_company c ON c.id = o.company_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_count, SUM(i.received_qty - i.returned_qty) AS received_qty, (array_agg(i.material_sku_id ORDER BY i.seq))[1] AS first_sku_id FROM pur_order_item i WHERE i.purchase_order_id = o.id) agg ON true
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.no, d.kind, d.doc_type, d.status, d.doc_date, w.name AS warehouse_name, COALESCE(agg.purchase_qty, 0) AS purchase_qty, agg.dye_lots_text, d.logistics_no FROM inv_doc d LEFT JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = CASE WHEN d.kind = 'IN' THEN d.to_warehouse_id ELSE d.from_warehouse_id END LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(i.purchase_qty) AS purchase_qty, string_agg(DISTINCT i.dye_lot, ',' ORDER BY i.dye_lot) AS dye_lots_text FROM inv_doc_item i WHERE i.doc_id = d.id) agg ON true WHERE d.source_type = 'PURCHASE_ORDER' AND d.source_id = #{id} AND d.status <> 'VOIDED' ORDER BY d.id
